title: Ezekiel
author: Ezekiel the priest and prophet.
date: During the Babylonian exile in the sixth century B.C.
historicalSetting: Ezekiel declares God's glory, judgment, restoration, new heart, and future temple hope.
keyVerse: Ezekiel 36:26 — "I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you."
christFocus: Ezekiel points to Christ as the true Shepherd, the giver of the Spirit, and the One through whom God's presence dwells with His people.
